findings.title: sysid adoption interval misses the true UA on 14 of 22 fits it admits; admitted fits biased high
findings.claim: Under white room-sensor noise of 0.01-0.05 degC, 14 of the 22 two-state sysid fits that adoption_decision admits have the true UA outside their own 95 % interval (nominal ~5 %), and 21 of 22 over-estimate UA (mean +7.26 %, max +18.64 %).
findings.mechanism: The gate admits only fits whose profile interval is finite and narrow; with the comfort-bounded collinear window the realisations that produce a sharp profile are a biased subset (ensemble 95 % half-width of log UA 0.15-0.27 against admitted reported 0.05-0.09). findings.title: Hot water without a tank probe: every solve starts from the 55 C ThermalState default, never advanced
findings.claim: With hot water configured and dhw_temp_entity omitted (the config flow's default install), the coordinator hands the solver dhw_temperature = 55.0 C on every cycle. In a 24-cycle closed loop, 23 of 24 solves start more than 1 K away from the tank the integration's own model says it left, and the model-truth tank spends 6.25 h of the demand windows below dhw_min_temperature, against 0 h with the probe mapped.
findings.mechanism: coordinator._update_current_state writes _current_state.dhw_temperature only from an ok reading of CONF_DHW_TEMP_ENTITY (coordinator.py ~5431), and no other producer advances it. So _solve_snapshot deep-copies the ThermalState dataclass default of 55.0 into every solve, and the optimizer uses initial_state.dhw_temperature as the tank's initial temperature. The plan therefore always believes the tank was just charged, schedules little DHW, and the next cycle resets to 55 again. _dhw_probe_temperature already fences this constant away from the display and the learners, but the solver is not fenced. slab_temperature is the same seam when floor_return_temp_entity is omitted: it is seeded once to room+1 K and never advanced (1 distinct solver-initial value in 24 solves, against 23-24 with the probe).

findings.mechanism: CurrentPriceSensor.native_value reads data['current_price'] = coordinator._get_current_price() -> _current_spot_price(), which returns the first entry with starts_at <= now < starts_at + 1 h. That test assumes hourly entries. The coordinator ingests 15-minute days (quarters_from_entries, #19), and there the first match is up to 45 min old. get_current_action picks the step covering now, so Heat Pump Action's price attribute and the price sensor disagree.

evidence.contention_note: other D8/finder seats running on the box; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: price15.py --fix: _current_spot_price treats an entry as covering [its start, the next entry's start)

findings.metric_definition: Of 96 instants (7 min into each quarter of 2026-01-15, Europe/Stockholm), count where the sensor's native_value differs from the price entry whose quarter covers now.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every published or booked 'price of now' equals the price entry whose interval [start, next start) contains now, at any price resolution.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'timedelta(hours=1)' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py  (every price-covering-now search with a fixed 1 h window)

null_control.note: same day at hourly resolution: 0 wrong, so the effect is the resolution assumption

reproduction_steps: price15.py --cycle -> after a real cycle at 06:40 sensor 1.00 vs current_action.price 0.92 (RESULT cycle_sensor_minus_plan=0.0800)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator._current_spot_price: cover [start, next start) (fall back to +1 h only for the last entry); the settlement and comfort learner share _get_current_price, so they are fixed together.

findings.title: DHW Heating Schedule counts 15-minute steps as 'heating periods', disagreeing with DHW Heating Plan's slot count
findings.claim: In every DHW-enabled matrix cycle (92 of 92), sensor.heat_pump_optimizer_dhw_heating_schedule publishes a 'heating periods' count different from the DHW Heating Plan's slot_count for the same schedule.
findings.mechanism: DHWScheduleSensor.native_value counts dhw_schedule steps with dhw_power > 0.1 and labels them periods. _plan_slots merges consecutive steps above 0.05 into slots. A multi-step slot is counted once by the plan and once per step by the schedule sensor.

evidence.contention_note: other seats running; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: matrix.py --perturb-dhw-runs: native_value counts contiguous runs of dhw_power > 0.05 (run on --only +dhw, 6 cells, baseline 12)

findings.metric_definition: Count of (cell, cycle) where the integer leading DHW Heating Schedule's state differs from DHW Heating Plan's slot_count, both available.
findings.phenomenon_property: Two entities summarising one plan state the same count of heating periods: a period is a contiguous run at the plan's own threshold.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: DHWScheduleSensor.native_value counts contiguous runs at the _plan_slots threshold (or reads dhw_plan slot_count).

findings.title: Recommended Power publishes a sub-threshold draw at steps Heat Pump Action reports 'off'
findings.claim: At plan steps whose space power lies between 0.05 kW and the on-threshold max(0.1, 0.5*min_power), Recommended Power (and Heat Pump Action power_kw) publish that power while the same action has heat_pump_on=False and Heat Pump Action reads 'off'.
findings.mechanism: entity.commanded_power_kw returns power + dhw_power and never reads heat_pump_on. get_current_action classifies such a step as off (below on-threshold) but keeps the continuous power.

evidence.unit: horizon steps (5 topologies x 96 steps at min_power 1.0 kW); worst 0.41 kW
evidence.contention_note: other seats running; count is contention-immune

findings.instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.sensor:CurrentPowerSensor.native_value and sensor:HeatPumpActionSensor.native_value, each step made current via optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.get_current_action + coordinator._build_data_dict

findings.phenomenon_property: No entity attributes a power draw to the pump at a step the same action declares off (heat_pump_on False).

leads.what: The same 1 h window prices the settlement's pending dict and the comfort learner's relative price. With quarter-hour prices, booked costs (lifetime cost accumulators, ledger) would use a quarter up to 45 min old.
The climate entity's recommended_power_kw shares commanded_power_kw, which ignores heat_pump_on (D8-s1-03). It likely publishes a power at steps its hvac_action calls off.
Static enabled_default False even when a mixing valve is configured. Without a valve it is available and permanently unknown instead of unavailable.

It prices candidate setpoints at ctx._current_state.outdoor_temperature, which is the 5.0 C ThermalState default without an outdoor thermometer. _effective_outdoor / forecast_outdoor_now exist for exactly this case.
On a DHW install without a tank probe, Thermal Battery charge/energy include the dhw_tank at the constant 55.0 C constructor default across cycles. It is disclosed as 'modelled' but not modelled.
